item.title: POLICE LOG
item.description: The Port Townsend Police Department (PTPD) logged a total of 135 calls from Jan. 17-23. item.title: The Big Stick
item.description: The supercarrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) glides into Port Townsend Bay on Feb. 2 on its way to Naval Magazine Indian Island. The ship is the fourth Nimitz-class, nuclear-powered aircraft carrier in the United States Navy. item.title: Hatchet attacker sentenced to 10 years
item.description: Anna Young, the woman convicted of attacking her husband in 2021 with the blunt end of a hatchet, was booked into Jefferson County Jail on Jan. 30 to begin her sentence. Formerly of Port Townsend, Young, 64, was sentenced in superior court to 10 years in prison and 36 months of probation supervised by the Department of Corrections. item.title: City considers landmark tree designation
item.description: The Port Townsend City Council authorized staff to move forward with an application to designate a Douglas fir located at the cityowned golf course as a landmark tree. item.title: Taking it to the street
